tools.name: check_page
tools.description: Website change monitor: watch public web pages (competitors, suppliers, policies, job and tender pages) and get every change, lines added and removed or a keyword appearing, by webhook (Slack, Discord, Zapier, Make, n8n) and RSS/JSON feed. Free for 3 pages. This tool checks one public page now (robo

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?via=mcp-registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_page · Public sink: check_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_page · Public sink: check_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
